evals.prompt: We just finished final-round interviews for a senior engineer role. 4 candidates, 3 interviewers each scored them. Candidate A is the strongest technically but quieter, Candidate B is a great communicator but less deep, Candidate C is well-rounded, Candidate D is high-potential but junior. Need a structured recommendation for the hiring committee, not just my gut feel.
evals.expected_output: A multi-scorer decision-spec aggregating all 3 interviewers' scores per candidate across technical-depth, collaboration, problem-solving, and ramp-time criteria, run through weighted-sum/topsis. Candidate A wins on the technical-depth weighting; result should note the aggregation across interviewers (mean/std_dev) and flag any near-ties or high score variance between interviewers as a caveat for the committee.
assertions: the skill produces a scored matrix
records a DEC
names a single winner with rationale
Candidate A ranks first
multiple scorers are aggregated (mean/std_dev) rather than only one interviewer's scores being used
